def merge(a, b):
    result = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            result.append(a[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(b[j])
            j += 1
    return result + a[i:] + b[j:]

fill-queens-diagonal:
def place(n, cols, out):
    if len(cols) == n:
        out.append(cols[:])
        return
    for c in range(n):
        if safe(cols, c):
            cols.append(c)
            place(n, cols, out)
            cols.pop()

out = []
place(4, [], out)
assert sorted(out) == [[1, 3, 0, 2], [2, 0, 3, 1]]
out = []
place(5, [], out)
assert len(out) == 10
